name: a partition relation on uncountable ordinals holding in one

phase_0.boundary_condition: the independence of the partition relation from ZFC
phase_0.domain_name: a partition relation on uncountable ordinals holding in one
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.chosen_element: forward morphism into the constructible universe
AFWD.justification: The forward morphism maps the abstract proposition into the specific model L, where the Erdos-Rado partition proof can be carried out under the assumption V=L.

AREV.chosen_element: reverse morphism constructing a MA counterexample
AREV.justification: The contravariant morphism descends from the proposition's negation into the model of Martin's Axiom plus ¬CH, building an explicit coloring of the pairs of ℵ₁ with two colours that witnesses the failure of the partition relation.

CLINK.chosen_element: composition of definition and model selection
CLINK.justification: CLINK chains the self-identification of the partition relation with the branching into distinct set-theoretic universes, so that the proposition is formally passed to the fork.

ENGAGR.chosen_element: live holding of both truth and falsity
ENGAGR.justification: ENGAGR holds the contradiction open, keeping the truth-in-L and falsity-in-MA simultaneously active as a single paraconsistent state, which is the structural signature of independence.

EVALF.justification: EVALF touches the constructive falsity branch: in the MA model, there exists a two-colouring of [ℵ₁]² with no uncountable homogeneous set, refuting the partition relation.

EVALT.chosen_element: proof that the relation holds in L
EVALT.justification: EVALT touches the constructive truth branch: under V=L, a homogeneous set of order type ω is guaranteed for any two-colouring of the pairs of ℵ₁, satisfying the partition relation.

FFUSE.justification: The two arms, one carrying the true verdict from L and the other the false verdict from the MA model, are multiplied back into a single joined state via the Belnap join, which when both truth and falsity are present yields the both state.

FSPLIT.justification: The split co-multiplies the proposition into two distinct set-theoretic environments: the constructible universe L and a universe satisfying MA+¬CH, each serving as an independent evaluation context.

IFIX.justification: IFIX fixes the both verdict as an irreversible, append-only fact: the partition relation is established as independent of ZFC and this result is sealed in the corpus.

IMSCRIB.justification: IMSCRIB posits the partition relation as a self-referential statement; it is the very object whose truth value will be explored, and it serves as its own identity anchor throughout the structure.

TANCH.justification: The system is closed by the metamathematical fact that the partition relation is independent of ZFC; the boundary is the limit of what ZFC can decide.

VINIT.justification: Before any model of set theory is fixed, the proposition 'κ→(κ,ω)² for κ=ℵ₁' has no assigned truth value; it is a bare statement without a universe to interpret it.

phase_2.fuse_result: both (true and false held together, indicating ZFC-independence)
phase_2.rejoin_note: The left arm constructs the Erdos-Rado proof in L and returns true; the right arm constructs a coloring without a homogeneous set in the MA model and returns false. The two arms rejoin via FFUSE into the both register. The kernel computes the B4 verdict over SIXTEEN_3; conflicting but well-constructed arms will resolve to B.
split_outputs: truth in the constructible universe L
falsity in a model of Martin's Axiom plus ¬CH
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) — true and false are both established across the two models, giving the live contradiction that signals independence.
phase_3.false_description: B4 F (10) — constructively refuted inside the MA+¬CH model.
phase_3.true_description: B4 T (01) — constructively proven true inside the constructible universe L.
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) — neither: the proposition is uninterpreted, no truth value is assigned.

steps.domain_action: no truth value exists for the partition relation before the set-theoretic multiverse is invoked
the statement 'κ→(κ,ω)² for κ=ℵ₁' is posited as a self-referential proposition
the proposition is fed into the split over possible models
the proposition's truth is evaluated separately in the constructible universe L and in a model of Martin's Axiom with ¬CH
in the L branch, the forward morphism constructs the Erdos-Rado partition proof under V=L
the evaluation in L yields true
in the MA branch, the backward morphism constructs a coloring without a homogeneous set
the evaluation in the MA model yields false
the two verdicts are rejoined into a single paraconsistent state holding both true and false
the simultaneous holding of both truth values is recognized as the independence status
the independence of the partition relation from ZFC is recorded as a permanent fact
the system is sealed, establishing the result as a theorem of metamathematics

phase_5.alfs_store: the ZFC axiom system, which serves as the canonical bootstrap store and the shared substrate for both models.
phase_5.compiler_frontend: the metamathematical apparatus that translates the statement and its two models into structural evaluations (forcing, inner model theory, partition calculus proofs).
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: logical embedding: the models communicate only through the external ZFC axioms they both satisfy, via relative consistency proofs and forcing relations.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: the universes of the two models (the constructible hierarchy L and the generic extension for MA+¬CH), each storing the sets needed for the evaluation.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: the meta-theoretic decision to place the proposition in two incompatible extensions of ZFC, ordered by the branching of the fork; the evaluations occur in parallel in the structure.

phase_6.cycle_cost: the computational and logical effort of building the two models and verifying the partition property or its failure inside each.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — the initial entropy of an undecided statement is replaced by the precisely matched information of its independence; no new logical strength beyond what was latent in ZFC is introduced, and the fork/fuse structure conserves the overall information content.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: the proposition is assigned the both verdict, a definite paraconsistent truth value.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: the partition relation is unassigned, an open question in ZFC.
